## Sprint 1 Completed Successfully

### Accomplishments
- Created complete expression module skeleton (cortical/got/expression/)
- Implemented AST nodes with frozen dataclasses for immutability
- Built full lexer with entity ID support (T-123 patterns)
- Created error hierarchy with context-aware formatting
- Implemented FunctionRegistry with @register decorator
- Added entities() method to Query builder with SchemaRegistry dispatch

### Test Coverage
- 94 behavioral tests (BDD scenarios)
- 168 unit tests
- 34 smoke tests (all passing)

### Key Files Created
1. cortical/got/expression/__init__.py (98 lines)
2. cortical/got/expression/ast.py (99 lines)
3. cortical/got/expression/lexer.py (304 lines)
4. cortical/got/expression/errors.py (184 lines)
5. cortical/got/expression/registry.py (85 lines)
6. cortical/got/query_builder.py (entities() method added)

### Critical Decisions
- FunctionCall.kwargs uses tuple of tuples (not dict) for hashability
- String-based dispatch via SchemaRegistry (EntityType enum only covers 5 of 12 types)
- DI container pattern for test isolation: create_container(got_dir=tmp_path)

### Next: Sprint 2
- T-007: Implement parser (expression → AST)
- T-008: Grammar definition
- T-009: Precedence handling
- T-010: Field validation
- T-011: Parser tests
- T-012: Sprint 2 validation gate

### Commit
808f576a feat(got): Sprint 1 - Expression module foundation
